newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tangshan Steel plans to offer 180 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Tangshan Steel plans to offer 180 mln A shares.

text.p: Tangshan Steel & Iron Co Ltd plans to launch an initial public offering of 180 million A shares next year, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The company, based in the city of Tangshan in Hebei province, has filed an application on the A share offer to local securities authorities, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The issue, which still requires final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, will be underwritten by China Guotai Securities, the official said.
The firm has not decided whether to list the equity in Shenzhen or Shanghai, with pricing and timing of the IPO unfixed, he said.
Tangshan Steel currently has total share capital of 1.02 billion shares, consisting of 851 million state shares, 143 million legal person shares and 26 staff shares.
The firm, which became a joint-stock enterprise in 1994, is one of China's ten biggest steel works, the official said.

The company forecast net earnings of 440 million yuan for this year, compared with about 300 million yuan recorded in 1995 and 72 million yuan a year earlier, he said, adding that the figures are not audited.
